source: 李小平等(2026)《中国工业经济》第4期; public data package 李小平/
rubric: Ran the authors' do-file through ek stata; matched Table 1 (6 cols) and 附表3 (4 cols) to 4 decimals incl. t and Anderson LM / CD F

Notices that l3./l4.lnbk70 (and lnedu70, l.lnedu70) are identical within country, so one instrument is dropped as collinear: cols (1)-(2) are just-identified; col (1) is weak (CD 10.31 < Stock-Yogo 16.38) and the -3.10 coefficient is ~180x OLS
Notes 1970 instruments are time-invariant (lags only trim the sample; FE absent in cols 1-2) and exclusion restriction is doubtful (historical books/education affect inequality directly)
Notes Bartik/leave-one-out IVs' exclusion threats (global common shocks); reports unsupported GMM honestly
Overall verdict: numbers replicated; direction of conclusion consistent; causal claim only suggestive
